parent_objective: run one smoke-scale guarded PPO proposal from alpha_1_0 and gate it without promotion
blocked_by: M971 designs readiness but the smoke PPO proposal has not been run
invalidates: longer PPO from alpha_1_0 before smoke proposal proof/generalization result

public_gates: M972 must run only smoke-scale PPO
M972 must not use private holdout
M972 must preserve the P0 actor-input contract
M972 must gate raw PPO against alpha_1_0 proof replay stack
M972 must gate raw PPO against fresh generalization and behavior ablations
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run medium or long PPO
do not skip proof replay gates
do not accept aggregate eval if wrong-history proof washes out

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo_readiness: first guarded PPO proposal from promoted alpha_1_0 base
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs and gates one smoke-scale PPO proposal
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: smoke PPO proposal diagnostic only; no promotion, no private holdout, no long-run claim
stop_condition: stop if raw PPO fails or training metrics are non-finite
stop if proof replay gates fail
stop if fresh generalization or behavior ablations regress
fallback_plan: if raw candidate passes all gates, route to full public-gate design
if proof or generalization fails but raw movement is useful, route to exact repair/projection design
if training is unstable, route to PPO recipe audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M971 designs guarded PPO readiness from alpha_1_0

hypothesis: A 1024-step guarded PPO proposal from alpha_1_0 can run and be evaluated against proof, fresh generalization, and behavior gates without promotion.
success_criteria: fresh randomized eval summary is written
behavior summary and comparison are written
no promotion or private holdout occurs
failure_criteria: fresh generalization or behavior gates are skipped
decision_rule: M972 may only run one smoke PPO proposal and gates. It must not promote, use private holdout, run longer PPO, or claim final driver improvement.
next_blocker: M971 readiness design has not been implemented as a smoke PPO proposal
